name: myself-op-watcher
description: Single-file watcher that subscribes to Supabase Realtime and invokes the user's local agent (openclaw) when ingest events arrive.

scripts.build: npm run build:assets && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=../public/myself-op.js
